description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Switchboard is rebuilding the commercial insurance brokerage with a digital stack that combines humans and AI agents to serve America’s small businesses. The Junior Software Engineer will build and ship production features end to end across the full stack, including backend, frontend, infrastructure, and deployment, while working closely with senior engineers and founders.
Junior full-stack software engineer shipping AI-agent features across web applications and cloud infrastructure

Responsibilities:
• Build and ship features end to end with AI agents
• Contribute to the full-stack (backend, frontend, infrastructure, deployment). We ship features from concept to production in days not weeks. Our tech stack includes: Ruby on Rails 8.1, Hotwire (Turbo + Stimulus), Postgres, and AWS, but experience with Rails is not required
• Write production-grade code with tests, handle edge cases, and own what you ship
• Pair with senior engineers and founders, learning by doing

Requirements:
• You've built and shipped something real whether that's a side project, an open-source tool, etc
• Strong CS fundamentals: data structures, systems design, ability to reason about how things work under the hood
• first principles knowledge is
• You use AI tools to write code and are intentional about how you work
• Effective cross-disciplinary communicator

Preferred:
• familiarity with any OOP language
• open-source contributions or publicly visible work
